blocks.html: The pagination and timing details of a search result.

types.name: skip
types.description: The number of documents skipped before the returned hits.

types.name: take
types.description: The maximum number of hits returned.

types.name: count
types.description:
Usually it's an estimate on the count, very few providers return an exact count.
If the user didn't ask for a count, it's `null`.

types.name: next_cursor
types.description:
The cursor to pass in the next query's pagination to retrieve the next page,
on providers that paginate with cursors.

types.name: query
types.description: The free-text query the result was computed for.

types.name: processing_time_ms
types.description: How long the search engine took to run the query, in milliseconds.
